items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: if you’re not familiar with this person, one of the great people to spearhead that was Cobi Narita... But I mean she would organize these jazz festivals... And what she did was just incomparable.

ctx.x: Wow. So back briefly to the women in jazz. In the 70s there were some women jazz festivals and so forth, and a concerted effort to sort of level the playing field a little bit. Did you participate?

Absolutely yes. And I have to say that if you’re not familiar with this person, one of the great people to spearhead that was Cobi Narita. N-A-R-I-T-A and her real full title is Nobuko Cobi Narita. She’s in Wikipedia. So I mean she’s covered a lot on the internet. But I mean she’s still alive but I mean she has Parkinson’s and she doesn’t do as much © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

now. But I mean she would organize these jazz festivals and get hold of a club and then hold you know all these concerts of women in jazz and do huge, beautiful publicity, great flyers with blown-up shots. You had to give her a blown-up shot with you playing with the horn really prominent. And she really just knew the whole business and all the angles and what to do, how to promote, and always keeping up with who were the players coming up on the scene, the women, and making sure to fit them in, and the older…
